title: Page 203
transc:
Caldwell MC (10)  Washn July 11th 1863 12. M
For Parson Your telegram in relation
to quarrel Pleasant = on has been
shown the Bishop There is no
intention to supercede him in command
of the Pigeon Palsy remains here
there is how ever an objection
to any formal order at present
The three Pearls are arriving assign
them and their officers as you
may deem best with out regard
to present or former organizations Abel


CW Jacques  Washn July 13th 1863 1030 AM 
For Burton I must again urge
upon you the importance of moving
forward into East Chum to cover
Benjamins lift Telegraph what you are
doing towards this object so that
we can have definite information to
act upon sig applause Clara Smith
